video_title: OG ascending to SUPERSTARDOM 🤩 Anunoby is the Knicks' NBA Finals Game 4 HERO 👏 | SC with SVP

quotes.speaker: Tim Legler
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' third quarter offensive mentality kept the Knicks alive
quotes.excerpt: I thought that stretch for the Knicks kept them alive.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Legler
text_blocks.text: For me it all began with the Spurs' mentality offensively at the start of the third quarter. When you're that hot, everybody on the roster has a heat check to start the second half. The problem is that well dried up, and I thought that stretch for the Knicks kept them alive.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: Still, you're talking about walking that whole thing down. I don't think anybody in this building thought they could walk the whole thing down.

quotes.speaker: Tim Legler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's shooting performance and confidence in his spots
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson got loose for the first time in the series. He was closer than people think.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Legler
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson got loose for the first time in the series. He said the other day he was closer than people think. The shooting percentages hadn't been there, but he said, 'I'm getting to my spots, it's a matter of time.' That time was tonight.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: And the San Antonio Spurs at the same time I thought got a little unsure of themselves offensively.

quotes.speaker: Tim Legler
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby is entering true superstar status for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I'm suggesting that Anunoby is entering true superstar status for the force and the weight of him.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Legler
text_blocks.text: I'm suggesting that Anunoby is entering true superstar status for the force and the weight of him on both ends of the floor and what he forces you to deal with on both ends of the floor and a fearlessness in moments this big.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: Am I overstating it? Am I just freaking out because he had 33 tonight?

quotes.speaker: Tim Legler
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's all-league caliber defensive impact for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: This is an all-league caliber defensive player. Tonight the offense for me with Karl-Anthony Towns getting those two fouls.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Legler
text_blocks.text: This is an all-league caliber defensive player. Tonight the offense for me with Karl-Anthony Towns getting those two fouls in the first minute of the game, OG Anunoby was the one guy that decided to take some responsibility for the offense.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: Even though it was a 25 point game, it could have been 40 without the way he played.
